plugins.name: howtotalk
plugins.description: Meta Communication Agent — routes among 14 communication frameworks (NVC, Getting to Yes, Never Split the Difference, Radical Candor, Crucial Conversations, Difficult Conversations, Active Listening, DESC, Influence, Motivational Interviewing, SCARF, Socratic Method, Storytelling). Invoke /howtotalk.

skills.name: active-listening
skills.description: Active Listening (Carl Rogers + modern extensions) -- master the skill of truly hearing another person. Covers 5 levels of listening, core techniques (paraphrasing, reflecting, summarizing), barriers, and practice exercises. The single most impactful communication skill.
headings: Active Listening — The Foundation of All Communication
skills.description_zh: 学习基于 Carl Rogers 及现代扩展的主动倾听，涵盖五个倾听层次、复述、情感反映、总结、常见障碍和练习，帮助真正理解对方。

skills.name: crucial-conversations
skills.description: Crucial Conversations (Patterson, Grenny, McMillan, Switzler) - Talk when stakes are high, opinions vary, and emotions run strong
headings: Core Concept: The Pool of Shared Meaning (공유 의미의 풀)
Step 2: Learn to Look (관찰하는 법을 배워라)
Step 4: Master My Stories (나의 이야기를 통제하라)
Step 5: STATE My Path (STATE 기법으로 말하라)
Step 6: Explore Others' Paths (상대방의 길을 탐색하라)
skills.description_zh: 运用 Patterson 等人的关键对话方法，在利害关系重大、意见不同且情绪强烈时开展沟通。

skills.name: desc
skills.description: DESC Assertiveness Framework -- structured 4-step method for assertive communication. Describe facts, Express feelings, Specify requests, state Consequences. Includes assertiveness spectrum, I-statements, broken record, fogging, and practice simulations.
skills.description_zh: 运用 DESC 四步法进行坚定表达：描述事实、表达感受、提出具体请求、说明后果；包含表达强度、自我陈述、重复立场、雾化回应及模拟练习。

skills.name: Difficult Conversations
skills.description:
Difficult Conversations (Stone, Patton, Heen — Harvard Negotiation Project).
Navigate conflict by understanding the Three Conversations beneath every disagreement.
Shift from a battle of messages to a learning conversation.
headings: The Three Conversations Model (세 가지 대화 모델)
The Trap: The Truth Assumption (진실 가정의 함정)
The Shift: From Truth to Contribution (진실에서 기여로)
The Trap: Feelings Are Irrelevant (감정은 상관없다는 함정)
The Shift: Acknowledge Before Problem-Solving (문제 해결 전에 감정 인정)
The Trap: All-or-Nothing Thinking (전부 아니면 전무 사고)
Ground Your Identity Before the Conversation
Opening Lines Using the Third Story
Safety Warning: When NOT to Use This Framework
skills.description_zh: 运用哈佛谈判项目 Stone、Patton、Heen 的艰难对话方法，理解分歧背后的三类对话，将冲突中的立场交锋转为相互学习。

skills.name: getting-to-yes
skills.description: Getting to Yes (Fisher & Ury, Harvard Negotiation Project) - Principled negotiation that separates people from problems and focuses on interests
headings: Getting to Yes — Principled Negotiation Skill
Principle 1: Separate the People from the Problem (사람과 문제를 분리하라)
Principle 2: Focus on Interests, Not Positions (입장이 아닌 이해관계에 집중하라)
Principle 3: Invent Options for Mutual Gain (상호 이익을 위한 선택지를 만들어라)
Principle 4: Insist on Objective Criteria (객관적 기준을 고집하라)
BATNA — Best Alternative to a Negotiated Agreement (합의 불발 시 최선의 대안)
Dealing with Dirty Tricks (더러운 수법 대처)
skills.description_zh: 运用 Fisher 与 Ury 的原则谈判方法，把人与问题分开，围绕各方利益寻求共识。

skills.name: howtotalk
skills.description: Meta Communication Agent -- the router/orchestrator that selects the best communication framework(s) based on your situation. Analyzes context, routes to the optimal framework pipeline, resolves conflicts between approaches, and provides integrated guidance. Like /think but for human communication strategy.
headings: Pipeline 6: Motivating Someone Resistant to Change
Pipeline 7: Saying No Without Burning Bridges
skills.description_zh: 分析人际沟通情境，选择并编排合适的沟通框架，协调不同方法之间的冲突，提供综合沟通策略。

skills.name: influence
skills.description: Influence (Robert Cialdini) - The 7 principles of persuasion for ethical influence and defense against manipulation
headings: Influence — The Psychology of Persuasion Skill
Influence Analysis — What's Being Used on You
skills.description_zh: 运用 Robert Cialdini 的七项说服原则开展符合伦理的影响，同时识别并防范操纵。

skills.name: Motivational Interviewing
skills.description:
Motivational Interviewing (Miller & Rollnick) — a collaborative, person-centered approach
to strengthening a person's own motivation for change. Resist the Righting Reflex.
Evoke their reasons, not yours.
headings: Change Talk vs Sustain Talk (변화 대화 vs 유지 대화)
skills.description_zh: 运用 Miller 与 Rollnick 的动机式访谈，通过合作及以人为中心的对话激发对方自身的改变动力，避免急于纠正，让对方表达自己的理由。

skills.name: never-split
skills.description: Never Split the Difference (Chris Voss) - FBI hostage negotiation tactics applied to everyday negotiation
headings: Never Split the Difference — FBI Negotiation Skill
Tactic 3: The Accusation Audit (비난 감사 / 선제적 부정 인정)
Tactic 4: "No" is the Start, Not the End ("아니오"는 시작이다)
Tactic 7: The Rule of Three (3의 법칙)
skills.description_zh: 将 Chris Voss 的 FBI 人质谈判技巧应用到日常谈判，支持协商策略与对话设计。

skills.name: nvc
skills.description: Nonviolent Communication (Marshall Rosenberg) - Transform conflict into connection through observation, feelings, needs, and requests
headings: Jackal vs Giraffe Language (자칼 vs 기린 언어)
When NVC Doesn't Work: Emergency Empathy
skills.description_zh: 运用 Marshall Rosenberg 的非暴力沟通方法，通过观察、感受、需要和请求，将冲突转为连接。

skills.name: Radical Candor
skills.description:
Radical Candor (Kim Scott) feedback framework — Care Personally while Challenging Directly.
Navigate the 2x2 matrix to give praise and criticism that drives growth without destroying trust.
Based on Kim Scott's experience at Google and Apple under Sheryl Sandberg and Steve Jobs.
headings: Step 2: Use the SBI Framework (SBI 프레임워크)
Step 3: Be Humble, Not Arrogant (겸손하게, 오만하지 않게)
Step 5: Praise More Than Criticize (비판보다 칭찬을 더 많이)
Step 2: Listen to Understand (이해하기 위해 들어라)
skills.description_zh: 运用 Kim Scott 的彻底坦诚反馈框架，在关心个人的同时直接提出挑战，借助二维矩阵给出有助成长且保持信任的表扬与批评。

skills.name: scarf
skills.description: SCARF Model (David Rock, NeuroLeadership) -- understand and manage the 5 social domains that trigger threat or reward responses in the brain. Use for team management, feedback, change leadership, negotiations, and any interpersonal interaction where emotions run high.
headings: SCARF Model — Social Threat & Reward Framework
2. Certainty — Ability to Predict the Future
3. Autonomy — Sense of Control Over Events
4. Relatedness — Sense of Safety with Others (Friend vs Foe)
skills.description_zh: 运用 David Rock 的 SCARF 模型理解五类社会需求如何触发威胁或奖励反应，适用于团队管理、反馈、变革领导、谈判及情绪强烈的人际互动。

skills.name: Socratic Method
skills.description:
The Socratic Method — lead people to insight through disciplined questioning, not instruction.
Six types of Socratic questions. Seminar format. When to use and when NOT to use.
Named after Socrates (469-399 BC), who claimed to know nothing except how to ask questions.
headings: The Six Types of Socratic Questions (소크라테스식 질문의 6가지 유형)
Type 3: Probing Evidence and Reasoning (증거/논리 탐구 질문)
Type 4: Questioning Viewpoints and Perspectives (관점/시각 질문)
Type 5: Probing Implications and Consequences (함축/결과 질문)
Type 6: Questions About the Question (질문에 대한 질문)
The Socratic Seminar Format (소크라테스 세미나 형식)
Process: Applying the Socratic Method (적용 프로세스)
Step 1: Identify the Claim or Belief (주장/신념 파악)
skills.description_zh: 运用苏格拉底式提问引导对方形成洞见，包含六类问题、研讨形式，以及适用和不适用的情境。

skills.name: Storytelling Frameworks
skills.description:
Storytelling frameworks for business, presentations, interviews, and persuasion.
Hero's Journey, STAR, PAS, Pixar Story Spine, Nancy Duarte's Sparkline.
Stories are how humans make sense of complexity and remember what matters.
headings: Framework 4: Pixar Story Spine (픽사 스토리 스파인)
skills.description_zh: 为商业沟通、演讲、面试及说服选择叙事框架，涵盖英雄旅程、STAR、PAS、Pixar 故事骨架与 Nancy Duarte 的 Sparkline，帮助理解复杂信息并记住重点。
